snippet.title: Brick Buster - PlayStation 5 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Players embark on a journey through different levels, breaking bricks and collecting bonuses in order to achieve the highest score. With its classic arcade-style gameplay, Brick Buster keeps you on your toes as you strategically bounce the ball off the paddle and try to destroy every brick in your path. Collect a variety of power-ups to take your game to the next level and prepare to smash your way to glory!

Developed by Aristo Studio s.r.o.
Also released for PlayStation 4
